name: zortex-bootstrap
description: Connect user-named apps through declarative local Zortex recipes instead of Codex built-in apps.

interface.shortDescription: Connect apps through local Zortex recipes, not Codex apps.
interface.longDescription: On an explicit app connection request, resolves a local Zortex recipe into receipt-backed bounded onboarding; unmatched apps enter the existing connector-fabrication workflow instead of being falsely marked connected.
defaultPrompt: Connect my Gmail, Google Drive, and Outlook through Zortex, not Codex apps.
Show the status of my Zortex connections.
